title: Shell-exec cd/pushd clamp skips options and -- before taking the target so cd -P /etc, cd -- /etc and cd - cannot escape the project root (SAFE-3)
description: shell-exec cd/pushd clamp skips options and -- before taking the target so cd -P /etc, cd -- /etc and cd - cannot escape the project root (SAFE-3)
acceptance_criteria: shell-exec refuses before spawn (exit 2, SAFE-3) when cd/pushd reach an outside target after option words (-P, -L, -e, -@, -PL, pushd -n) or a terminating --; a lone - (OLDPWD), options with no target (home) and target/option words still holding quoting or expansion characters after outer-quote strip also refuse; cd/pushd with or without options to a target inside the project root stay allowed
